The failing test is related to the method `sample(int)` in the class `org.apache.commons.math3.distribution.DiscreteDistribution`. The test tries to sample an array from a discrete distribution, but an `ArrayStoreException` occurs. This exception typically arises when trying to store an element of the wrong type in an array.

The test creates pairs with anonymous object instances as keys, then tries to sample from the `DiscreteDistribution` constructed with that list and asserts the length of the sample array.
